title: Shura no Hakoniwa
synopsis: Utsuro is an unidentified monster whose favorite food is the "nectar" bioenergy that only young girls possess. Iruka Natsumi, a member of Hyakkaen, an organization that fights Utsuro day and night, lives in fear of being eaten by Utsuro. One day, a girl named Sagara Asuka appears before her. Asuka declares, "I will defeat all the Utsuro in this world with my own hands," and tells Natsumi that they will live together until she turns 19, when the nectar disappears from her body. Asuka shows overwhelming strength in her battle with Utsuro, but she has a secret... (Source: Natalie, translated)

titleRomaji: Okiraku Ryoushu no Tanoshii Ryouchi Bouei: Seisan-kei Majutsu de Na mo na Kimura wo Saikyou no Jousai Toshi ni
titleEnglish: Easygoing Territory Defense by the Optimistic Lord: Production Magic Turns a Nameless Village into the Strongest Fortified City
titleNative: お気楽領主の楽しい領地防衛 ～生産系魔術で名もなき村を最強の城塞都市に～
synopsis: Van, the fourth son of a powerful noble, is only two years old when he remembers his past life as a salaryman in Japan. With his adult brain in a young body, he’s considered a child prodigy…until he displays the “Production Magic” skill when he turns eight. In a family that favors offensive magic, this crafting skill is considered useless in battle, and Van is banished to oversee a tiny country town in disgrace. With only his personal maid, the memories of his past life, and his “worthless” magic, can Van improve the fortunes of this little village—and himself? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

synonyms: The Trading Mermaid and Sora’s First Love
The Trading Mermaid and Blue Sky's First Love
synopsis: Sara, a mermaid living in the modern world, has been dealing with yokai and humans alike as a “Trader.” To her, humans are merely clients—trusting them with her heart was never an option… One day, a mysterious young man named Sora wanders into her miniature garden. He doesn’t seem like an enemy, but there’s clearly something unusual about him. Sara offers him a deal. However, the one thing Sora truly desires turns out to be none other than Sara herself…!? A cohabitation romance filled with love and secrets begins—all starting from a single “deal”! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)
